files.content:
# ATLAS Example Plugin

Replace this README with the purpose, setup, permissions, and usage instructions
for your plugin. Keep the plugin ID stable after you publish it.

This starter plugin has no privileged ATLAS capabilities and makes no network
requests.

ATLAS PLUGIN TEMPLATE

Example Plugin

Your plugin starts here. Replace this page with its interface.

Ready
